faq.title: Deploying awg-gui
faq.intro: This app SSHes into your VDS and runs the official production installer. Root/sudo credentials are only needed during install.
faq.reqBody: Linux (Ubuntu, Debian, Fedora, CentOS/RHEL/Rocky/Alma), root or sudo, KVM or /dev/net/tun. Docker and curl are installed automatically if missing.
faq.portsBody: SSH — usually 22. Panel — 8877 (HTTP). AmneziaWG UDP — 51820 (and following ports for extra configs). Open them in your firewall/security group.
faq.cmdBody:
curl -fsSL …/dist/install.sh | sudo bash -s -- --yes

Non-interactive: panel port 8877, AmneziaWG kernel module on by default.
faq.kernelBody: Recommended for stable YouTube/Instagram ABR over full-tunnel + resolver. You can skip it at install time and stay on userspace amneziawg-go.
faq.securityBody: The app gets full server access over SSH. Passwords stay on the device only. There is no relay — traffic goes directly to your VDS.
faq.afterBody: The app waits for the panel, signs in as admin, and opens it in an embedded WebView.

install.title: Install on VDS
install.mockHint: Browser uses mock SSH (no real server). Android uses real SSH.

panel.title: Panel
panel.missing: No saved connection. Install awg-gui first.
panel.webHint: Browser auto-login WebView is limited by CORS. On Android a native WebView opens.
